cards.title: Live support chat

cards.title: Full accountability
cards.desc: Every action on your account — deposits, withdrawals, adjustments — is permanently logged. Nothing happens without a record.

items.quote: I've tried three other platforms. Vestora is the only one where I actually understand what's happening with my money.
The AI portfolio has returned 14% in eight months. I haven't touched it once — that's exactly what I wanted.
Starting with $500 felt embarrassing before. Vestora made it feel completely normal. Now I'm at $4,800.
The rebalancing alone has saved me hours every month. It just quietly does its job in the background.
I recommend Vestora to everyone who tells me investing feels too complicated. It genuinely isn't, here.
Clean, fast, and the fees are exactly what they say they are. No surprises after six months of use.

items.a: Create an account, sign in, and open the deposit or investment area from your dashboard.
Choose an available deposit method and submit the request. The team reviews and verifies the transaction before it is applied to the account according to the platform workflow.
Submit a withdrawal request from your account. It must be reviewed and approved through Vestora's verification process before funds are released.

items.q: Where can I see investment terms?
items.a: Available plans show their amount range and term. Review all plan details and risks before creating an investment.

items.q: How do I secure my account?
items.a: Use a strong password and enable two-factor authentication in account settings when available.
Use the support chat from the website or dashboard to send your question to the Vestora team.
